description: Multiband ducker: the key input and the main input are split into matching bands, and every band of the main input is turned down by the level measured in the matching band of the key input

params.text: Sets how strongly the level measured in the key input drives the ducking
Sets the most a band can be turned down
Sets how quickly a band is turned down as the key input gets louder
Sets how quickly a band returns to full level after the key input gets quieter

inputs.text: The signal whose band levels control how far each band of the main input is turned down

outputs.text: The ducked signal, with its bands summed back together

notes: with nothing patched into the key input every band measures 0V, no band is turned down, and the main input passes through unchanged
